title: Kalaam : Mirza Aur Kumail
body:
Aye Aspe Bawafa mera baba kaha'n gaya
Aye Zuljana bata mera baba kaha'n gaya
1. Kyu'n khoo'n bhari hai zulfei'n kyun teer hai badan pa
tewar bata rahei'n hai kuch to hua hai ran me
tanha hai tu khada mera baba kaha'n gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Chup chaap kyu'n khada hai kuch bolta nahi hai
Bechain hai phuphi bhi aansu baha rahi hai
kuch to unhe bata mera baba kaha'n gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maidaa'n se jab bhi aaya baba ko tu hai laaya
is baar aye faras kyu'n sarwar(a.s) ko chordh aaya
beti ko kuch bata mera baba kaha'n gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Rehwaar tune dekha jab tujhko maine roka
waqte wida pidar ne seene pe tha sulaaya
Ab soungi kaha'n mera baba kaha'n gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Lashe uthaaye tune ansaare shahe dee'n ke
Dekha hai teer chalte masoom ke gale pe
Ab maajra hai kya mera baba kaha'n gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
6.
Mirza o Meer
tumne tahreer jo kiya hai
is gham se
Asghari
me nouha buka fugaa'n hai
Bacchi ka poochna mera baba kaha'n gaya
Kalaam : Mirza Aur Kumail
